profile.headline: Model-Based Developer | Embedded Software Engineer | AUTOSAR
profile.summary:
I am an Embedded Software Engineer with 8 years of experience in the automotive industry, specializing in AUTOSAR-based development, embedded C, and model-based design. I have 4 years of experience in Embedded C development (hand-coding) with ASPICE and MISRA compliance, focused on delivering robust and efficient application-layer software.

I also bring 4 years of hands-on AUTOSAR experience in BSW integration, application-layer development, and system integration using Vector’s DaVinci toolchain. Additionally, my background includes 4 years as a Model-Based Developer using MATLAB, Simulink, and Stateflow for automatic C/C++ code generation with dSPACE TargetLink in safety-critical automotive environments.

I’m experienced with Green Hills tool suites and debugging workflows, and have contributed to ASPICE Level 3 compliant projects. I value clean architecture, collaboration, problem-solving, and the delivery of high-quality embedded solutions.

Open to connecting, collaborating, and contributing to challenging embedded software projects that push engineering forward.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Development activities
•	Tool automation using python to control NI DAQs and UEI DAQs for test automation, reducing license cost by 40%.
•	Hight current power supply measurements mapping to IPEmotion software using python, reducing hardware cost in around 10K USD for each deployment (16 thermal chambers benefit from this, giving a total of ~160K USD cost reduction).
•	Thermal chamber automation with python for Sensor’s intercommunication between LabVIEW panel and IPEmotion software, reducing manual tunning on a 50%.
•	Integrating application models, sensor libraries, CAN dbc and CDD into Vector DaVinci project. This involved managing port interface and BSW connections using Davinci Developer and Configurator within the AUTOSAR architecture. 
•	Conducting model analysis to debug and identify root causes of issues in MATLAB models.
•	General C code Development, Bug fixes, and feature addition with Development Testing using development board, test bench, Renesas E2 debugger, CANoe, DET Tool and Renesas MULTI. 
•	Diagnostic Specification and CDD updated with MDX and Word document generation using Vector’s CANdelaStudio.
•	Developed C code for BSW integration with the automatically generated C code from MATLAB models.
•	Python script development and maintenance for project build (compilation) automation.

Testing activities 
•	Sleep/wakeup Test and Sleep current measurement.
•	Sanity and Integration Testing.
•	CPU Load and Stack measurement activities.
•	Unit test execution/creation for decision coverage with CANTATA software.
•	Achieved ASPICE Level 3 on SWE3, SWE4 and SWE5, being directly responsible for Unit Verification (SWE4) during assessment.
